text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah (Perancangan)

Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Pelan Struktur) 2023.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 November 2023.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan Pelan Struktur Kuala Lumpur 2040 hendaklah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Kaedah 2]

Salinan Fi per salinan

(RM)

(a) bahasa kebangsaan

(i) salinan cetak 120.00

(ii) bentuk elektronik percuma

(b) bahasa Inggeris

(i) salinan cetak 150.00

(ii) bentuk elektronik percuma

Dibuat 9 Oktober 2023

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VIII]

DATUK SR. HAJI KAMARULZAMAN BIN MAT SALLEH

Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur

Diluluskan 11 Oktober 2023

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VIII]

DATO' SERI ANWAR BIN IBRAHIM

Perdana Menteri

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF

STRUCTURE PLAN) RULES 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 9 and paragraph 64(2)(j) of the

Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of the City

of Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)

(Fee for Purchase of Structure Plan) Rules 2023.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 23 November 2023.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the Kuala Lumpur Structure Plan 2040

shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

(a) national language

(i) hard copy 120.00

(ii) electronic form free of charge

(b) English language

(i) hard copy 150.00

(ii) electronic form free of charge

Made 9 October 2023

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VIII]

DATUK SR. HAJI KAMARULZAMAN BIN MAT SALLEH

Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur

Approved 11 October 2023

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VIII]

DATO' SERI ANWAR BIN IBRAHIM

Prime Minister
